Open [set-aside version A](http://maker:4001/archive.html?mode=menu). On the A List Apart card, open the **•••** menu and choose **Move to Archive**.

Please check whether the card leaving All Bookmarks, the Archive count increasing, and the reassurance that it can be restored make “set aside without losing” clear.

I’ve assumed **Archive** is the right name and that this less-frequent action belongs in the card’s extra-actions menu—please check both choices.
